posts.author: Strahl
posts.body:
I've got something in the works. It's still a work in progress as the Buy/Sell functions aren't working properly yet. But I've got it set up so that selecting Chat will bring up a few topics to pick from, and they'll give you different answers in the chat window.
Features include
Parallax backgrounds: allowing you to draw the shop interior if you like, or you can just use whatever parallax you like.
Shop music: Allows you to play shop music, similar to Final Fantasy 1.
Shopkeep Portrait: Allows you to use a picture from the picture folder to show the shop keeper.
Chat options: Pick a chat option from the list, get a response back. It's all set in a call script before the shop initializes so it can be influenced by game variable/switches and conditional branches.
Things I still need to work on
Buy/Sell functionaliy.
Switch Chat and Cancel buttons.
Hide/move the touch UI buttons.
Give me a few days to hammer it all out.
